title: Dinagat, Cebu tourism surpass 1 million arrivals

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Four years after Typhoon Odette (international name: Rai) devastated Dinagat Islands, the province’s vibrant tourism industry is back on its feet, attracting over one million tourists who pumped in revenues worth at least half a billion pesos. Gov. Nilo Demerey Jr. highlighted the island-province’s post-disaster recovery milestones during the 20th foundation anniversary of Dinagat Islands on Oct. 3. Demerey traced the turnaround to institutional roadmaps rolled out by the provincial government, starting with the “Remedy” agenda drafted in 2022 and later refined into the target-specific “Remedy Targets” platform in 2025.
